description: This file defines types, functions, and classes related to managing and executing task flows within a plugin runtime environment, including session binding, flow creation, task execution, and flow state management.

classes.name: ManagedTaskFlowRecord
classes.description: Type representing a managed task flow record with additional sync mode and controller ID.

classes.name: BoundTaskFlowRuntime
classes.description: Interface representing a runtime environment for a task flow, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and executing tasks within a flow.

classes.name: PluginRuntimeTaskFlow
classes.description: Interface for creating and binding session-based task flow runtimes.

methods.name: createRuntimeTaskFlow
methods.description: Factory function that creates a PluginRuntimeTaskFlow instance with methods to bind sessions and create runtimes from tool context.
